propositions: Three hand-rolled nextPageToken cursor loops in acli_graph.py lack runaway-token guards and spin infinitely if the server repeats the same token
Offset-protocol pager fetcher._iter_pages includes same-page stall guards that cursor loops lack; this inconsistency must be remedied at a shared cursor-iterator seam
Server-repeating nextPageToken is a data-integrity signal that must propagate as RunawayPaginationError and escape the maps' fail-open exception handlers without degrading to a partial dict
A new shared _iter_cursor_pages iterator in acli_graph.py must drive POST-body tokens, terminate on isLast:true or absent token, and raise RunawayPaginationError on repeated non-null tokens

Each of the three maps must wrap its iterator consumption with 'except RunawayPaginationError: raise' ahead of its catch-all handler to preserve fail-open for ordinary transport faults while hardening against cabc runaway mode
